notes.title: VeeR Weekly Highlights 5.13 - 5.19
notes.content:
Hi VeeRians :) Check out what happened in the community last week!

[b][u]What To Watch[/u][/b]

[b]Art Bomb! Inside and Beyond[/b]
Take this educating and spectacular plunge into the world-known paintings through ARTE including A Bar at the Folies-Bergère by Édouard Manet, Isle of the Dead by Arnold Böcklin and Las Meninas by Diego Velázquez. Watch Now on [url=https://veer.tv/collections/W4zppN36neEuYDltVQaB3JB2FqU?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=referral]VeeR[/url]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29867910/0cf867b74819a9f1c97c6eb74722ae20e1867d62.jpg[/img]

[b]May the Force Be With You[/b]
Enjoy this collection as a tribute from VeeR Creator Community [url=https://veer.tv/collections/star-wars-13107?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=referral]here[/url]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29867910/f75bdb82ffde3b879c1ac6a0ab61346dcb55d29d.jpg[/img]

[b]The Prospects[/b]
Join this 360 VR animation about why humans are driven to uncover the secrets of the world through 4 scenes: the room of knowledge, the neutrino detector, the DNA, and the cosmos via [url=https://veer.tv/videos/the-prospects-vr-travel-45571?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=referral]VeeR[/url]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29867910/f42acc25f5380573693ae4da394df6ef57912d30.jpg[/img]
